title: Truth Hurts
coreMove: Turn the private ugly fact into a posted task before shame can hide it again.
sourcePressure: The source ties Wilmoth Irving's murder, racist hostility, school trouble, an Air Force aptitude failure, and the Accountability Mirror into truth plus disciplined follow-through.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: The writer must not make the mirror into positive self-talk, confidence, or a mood boost.

tryThisNow: Write goals on a sticky note
Look at yourself for one minute

exampleSpecs.domain: fire academy written-test remediation after a failed entrance score
exampleSpecs.audience: a recruit who blames nerves but cannot read the technical questions fast enough
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether he earns a retest slot or keeps hiding behind a heroic dream
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he writes the failed score beside the retest date on the dorm door, then blocks the first two chapters of code study on the calendar
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a red failed-score sheet folded inside a turnout-gear locker

exampleSpecs.audience: a nurse tempted to call a near miss a systems problem only
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether a patient gets harmed next shift because the personal miss stays unnamed
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she writes 'I skipped the barcode scan' on the review form before listing the staffing issue underneath it
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a medication label peeled halfway from a plastic IV bag

exampleSpecs.audience: an adult learner embarrassed by the reading section
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether embarrassment keeps her in a low track another semester
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she copies the lowest subscore onto the study plan, circles vocabulary, and signs up for the lab before leaving campus
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a placement printout creased under a vending-machine receipt

exampleSpecs.domain: public defender arraignment prep after a missed deadline
exampleSpecs.audience: a junior attorney protecting his image after a late filing
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether a client pays for his ego next time
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he tells the senior defender the exact missed calendar entry, then writes a new filing trigger into the case system while she watches
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a docket sheet with one deadline highlighted in orange

exampleSpecs.domain: youth boxing weigh-in after hidden diet slips
exampleSpecs.audience: an amateur fighter who keeps joking about the scale
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether he misses the bout because joking protects the lie
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: before stepping on, he predicts the number aloud, sees the miss, and writes the exact evening food cut on the gym board
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a digital scale glowing beside unlaced boxing shoes

exampleSpecs.domain: recovery sponsor call after a hidden relapse trigger
exampleSpecs.audience: a person who says everything is fine while rearranging facts
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether secrecy becomes the first step back into the old pattern
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he reads the exact receipt total into the phone, then pins tomorrow's meeting time above the apartment buzzer
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a crumpled receipt flattened beside a dead phone charger

skillTargets: identify truth paired with a visible task
choose a correction ritual after a failed standard
analyze when shame is hiding inside excuses

tryThisNowSpec: Write one sentence that names the private fact you keep softening, then attach a deadline and one visible proof of work to it.
